What this changes, and why, in a few plain sentences. For a bug: what went wrong, and how you found it.

- [ ] a check in the suite that would have caught it (CONTRIBUTING.md, "What a change needs")
- [ ] the docs say what users now see, and `core/tests/golden/` changes are intended
- [ ] a line in CHANGELOG.md under Unreleased, if users will notice
- [ ] every commit signed off (`git commit -s`)
